source: COMPOSED from @google/genai v2.27.0 src/errors.ts (class ApiError extends Error { status: number }, name 'ApiError') and src/_api_client.ts throwErrorIfNotOK (message = JSON.stringify(errorBody); for a non-JSON body {error:{message:text, code:status, status:statusText}}) and processStreamResponse (an SSE chunk with an `error` object, code 400–599 → ApiError with message `got status: ${status}. ${JSON.stringify(chunkJson)}`). Status/meaning per https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/reference/models/api-errors ; 429 message per https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/deploy/error-code-429 ; missing-signature text per https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thought-signatures (Agent Platform wording UNVERIFIED). The {error:{code,message,status}} envelope is Google's standard; no Agent Platform page example was fetched [UNVERIFIED]. Abort: the SDK rethrows the fetch error unchanged → DOMException name 'AbortError' (runtime behaviour); coax normalizes via signal.aborted.
